preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(c) <= 127 for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input have codes from 32 to 127 (inclusive).
The input contains at least one character other than a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(c) <= 127 for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output have codes from 32 to 127 (inclusive).
The output is the processed spell with unnecessary characters removed.
